strings.en: All right, that's everything set. Now it's up to Big Sis Diondra.
Indeed. Well done. ...Come quickly, Blue Jet...
...Still, leavin' the Earthlings alone
just to take on Rom's bunch... you're a strange one, ain'tcha?
Blue Jet... the first worthy opponent I have met in twenty years...
His Tenku Shinken and my Dark Twin Slayer Sword... we must settle this!
Just like Big Sis said...
Your type's got skill, but you're stubborn and hard to use...
Keep that up and you'll never get promoted, y'know?
Advancement in the Gyandlar matters naught to me...
As a swordsman, fighting strong foes is my sole reason for living!
All right, all right. Then you won't mind if I take the credit.
That suits me just fine. ...Hurry up, Rom's brats...!
(I am a swordsman... Battle is my life...)
We sure have a lot more Gundams now.
Yo, Lieutenant, what're you up to?
Oh, I came for maintenance... Just thinking we've got lots of Gundams.
True. The Zeta, the Double Zeta... and the Gundam Project units too...
Oh, that's right! Speaking of the Gundam Project...
wasn't there talk about a GP03?
GP03... Its code name was Dendrobium, I think.
You know your stuff, Lieutenant. Nina from Anaheim mentioned it.
She wouldn't show it to me, though. Said it was top secret.
...Top secret, huh.
(Unit 1 is a general-purpose ground type, Unit 2 is for nuclear strikes...
So what's Unit 3? High-mobility combat in space...?
But the Full Burnern already fills that role...)
Hiya, what're you talking about?
Oh, Excellen. You've been doing maintenance a lot lately.
Mmm, the Weiss has been acting up...
It gets worse every time we run into those bony, planty enemies.
Huh. But those enemies are creepy, huh? What do they even want?
...If they're attacking, it means they're hostile to us.
...But I can't tell what they're after.
Hey, don't you... hear a voice?
A voice? Whose?
...Nah, never mind. Okay then, maintenance, maintenance.
(Huh!? ...Could this be...?)
(...You... Excellen...)
(...I knew it... straight into my head... Who... are you!?)
(I want you to come... to me. You are...)
(Fine... by me... I've got things... to ask you... too...)
(Please come... You are... my...)
Huh? Excellen, you say something!? In the cockpit already?
Huh? Hey, Judau, is Excellen going somewhere?
Wait, something's wrong... Weissritter, please respond!
Excellen!?
...Launching...
Elle, contact Captain Bright! Judau, help me stop the Weiss...
No good, Lieutenant, looks like she's already fired it up.
Get close now and we'll get caught in it!
...I'm coming... Wait for me... I'll be right there...
What...!? Hazard, you'd have me do such a thing...!?
Ah, no, please don't direct your anger at me.
I heard this from that person...
Apparently, enemy forces are hidden in a certain derelict colony...
What...? I trust you've confirmed it?
Yes, of course. I sent Sherman right away, but... that place is...
Is what?
Yes, well... when you descended to Earth before, Lord Ilbora,
it's the point where the Earthlings regrouped just as you left, you see.
...But that doesn't mean it will be so this time. Why must I...
Ah, this is also a suggestion from those gentlemen...
That device you used when you descended to Earth, Lord Ilbora...
It's their condition for letting us use it again...
Those wretches... mere mechanical puppets, exploiting my weakness...!
Now, now, Lord Ilbora... Should you really be saying such things?
Your brilliant plan can't even begin without it, can it?
(Not much longer. Don't think the great Hazard'll stay like this forever,
you fools.)
What!? Excellen... deserted?
Apparently she was acting strangely.
They say she seemed almost hypnotized...
Whatever her state, the fact remains that she flew off the Ra Cailum
in the Weissritter. ...We have no choice but to search for her.
Whatever the case, this is bad.
The most irreplaceable and costly asset in any military is the pilot...
Jeez... Prospector, worry about Excellen
rather than the military budget!
So, you'd like us to search for Excellen...?
No, I'd like the Nadesico to head for the Gate of Zedan.
Where the new aliens were attacking, right?
If the Vega Star Federation hadn't hit Von Braun,
we'd probably be there by now...
The situation at the Gate of Zedan is urgent.
I'd like the Ra Cailum to go as well, but too much is happening around us.
We'll reassess the situation around us, then head for the Gate of Zedan.
Leave it to us, Captain Bright!
The Nadesico was built to take on the Jovian Lizards alone, after all!
Plus, we've got reliable pilots!
Heh, you get it!
I'm counting on you, Akito! Protect me again this time!
Uh, yeah.
Yamada. Learn the captain's patterns already.
It's what you'd call a running gag.
Jeez, Captain! You're in a briefing with Captain Bright,
so can't the chat with the Nadesico crew wait!?
Ugh... Okaaay. Megumi's so strict...
At worst, we may have to prioritize dealing with other incidents.
Frankly... you may consider this a solo Nadesico operation.
No, no, we have two whole battleships here.
Splitting up as the situation demands is quite economical, too.
It does split up our forces, though.
Are we really gonna be okay on our own?
We'll be fine! Because I believe in Akito!
Oh my... Akito's got a heavy responsibility.
Ahem. ...In any case, that concludes the operation briefing.
Now, head for the Gate of Zedan at once.
We'll get there as quickly as we can.
Roger! Minato, set course for the Gate of Zedan at full power!
Well then, Captain Bright, the battleship Nadesico is off
to live up to everyone's expectations!
Thank you. ...Don't overdo it.
He's warning you, you know.
Engine output at maximum. Nadesico, setting course for the Gate of Zedan.
Is this going to work?
Oh, having doubts? That Gato boy said the same thing.
Just keep quiet and leave it to me.
This operation... if any part of it stumbles, it will fail...
Even Lady Haman is concerned.
Oh? Then will the honorable Mashymre Cello run it all himself?
I don't mind either way... Heh heh heh.
...I'm confirming it precisely because I can't!
A man shouldn't get so flustered. Otherwise...
you'll be the one who trips up, you know?
And if that happens, I wonder what Lady Haman will say.
Ngh... Cima Fleet... commence the operation at once...!
I'll take my leave, then, Sir Knight of the Rose... Heh heh heh...
(I just can't handle that woman... For me, there's only Lady Haman...)
Confirmed the Nadesico has left this sector.
What now, Captain? We can't sit around either, right?
Where to next? If we stay on the moon... the enemy may attack again...
True. The moon has many key sites. Nergal's lunar dock, Anaheim HQ...
(Nina... I couldn't see her with things like this, but I'm glad she's safe...)
Uraki, what are you spacing out for?
...!! Y-Yes, sir! My apologies, Captain!
Lieutenant Uraki, weren't you thinking about Nina?
Ahh, she's a bit of an oddball, sure, but she's a looker.
It's a blessing in disguise that Ms. Nina Purpleton
and Anaheim Electronics came through that battle unharmed, but...
Yes... With Neo Zeon showing up too, we've lost too much time...
Exactly. We need to plan our course while factoring in the incidents
we'd meant to handle after the Gate of Zedan.
Plus, Big Bro Daisuke and Sis Excellen
are both gone now.
Daisuke... I'm sure he's fine, but...
he looked sick, from that Vegatron radiation or whatever...
Koji, I'm sure there's nothing to worry about. Maria's with him.
I wonder if Daisuke's okay...
The Vegatron radiation is eating away at his body, isn't it...?
Come on, he's got that tomboy sister with him... And Daisuke... no,
Duke Fleed isn't a man to lose to illness. I believe that...
Sure, Umon might pull through somehow...
But what about Excellen? Somebody saw her, right?
Yeah, me, Judau, and Lieutenant Uraki saw her, but...
she was acting weird. Muttering to herself...
Her medical report shows nothing particularly abnormal...
Uraki's report said she seemed almost as if
she were under hypnosis?
Yes, sir. To my eyes, she appeared to be under some... influence.
I agree.
If we don't chase her down fast, I've got a feeling things'll get ugly...
Captain, let's sort out the problems we're facing.
Right... First, Daisuke Umon...
For now, all we can do is leave him to Commander Hazuki on Earth...
Next, Excellen Browning's disappearance...
Can we go after her?
She ran off on her own, right? That girl. Just leave her be.
Huh, figured you'd be yelling along, Shinobu. You're awful quiet.
Shut up, Sara.
He's got a record, after all.
Now, now. Not much time has passed yet,
and the Weissritter's signal can still be tracked.
But it can only operate on its own for so long...
We'd better hurry, then.
As for the Gate of Zedan... we've sent the Nadesico on ahead for now.
I have some doubts about their strength, but...
They seem to be professionals too, in a different sense from us soldiers.
No need to fuss over them more than necessary.
Well, if we're gonna back them up, sooner's better, I guess.
Never mind that, what bugs me is that creepy rock.
The asteroid at PLS Black Point... The energy reading detected there
could very well be a sign of something...
Stuff like that's like a dam bursting. It starts small, then
it all gushes out at once...
R-Really...? That's kinda scary...
No use bein' jumpy. If it breaks, it breaks.
No, that'd be too late, Koji.
That's how it always goes. ...We just hit it with all we've got.
That's all you ever say, Tetsuya.
There's more. The unidentified units gathering at the meteor cluster.
If we know they're machines, aren't they the ones
most likely to start something?
With the Federation's units in space not functioning properly,
it's certainly hard to imagine they're friendly.
...Anyway, from the ones mentioned so far... um, these four,
we've got to hurry and decide where to go, right?
Given the urgency... yes, that's how it is...
Captain Bright...? Is something else bothering you...?
Was there somethin' else? I've totally lost track.
...Isn't it the derelict colony that went missing?
Oh yeah, there was that too.
Right. It's lower priority than the other incidents raised so far...
but it really bothers me...
A colony going missing is certainly an alarming anomaly...
But Captain, as things stand...
I know, Captain Quattro...
For now, we have to deal with the crises right in front of us first...
